Fee Reimbursement for Arya Vysya Community - Eligibility
Caste | Students belonging to Arya Vysya community
Family annual income | Rs. 1 lakhs with EWS or Form-G Caste and income certificate
Course Type | All
College Type | All except evening college and KSOU admitted students
College Seat Type | Excluding students admitted through Management, ComedK, Pvt seat in Pvt college, Students in KSOU and Evening colleges
Promotion status | Promoted to current year
Year repeater (Detained/Discontinued) | Not eligible
Sibling criteria | Only 2 boy children per family are eligible (no limit on girl child)
Previous year percentage | 50% & above for Specially abled students and 60% and above for other students
